rules.rule: No Tailwind anywhere in packages/ or apps/. All appearance must come from plain CSS `.lyra-*` classes and design tokens.

Design token values (colors, typography, spacing, radii, shadows, state styles) are final and pixel-perfect from the design handoff. Flag any change to token values that lacks an explicit justification.
Entry keyframe animations must animate transform only. The initial keyframe must never set `opacity: 0`.
`compat-shadcn.css` is an opt-in subpath and must never be imported by the main entry stylesheet.
The styles package must never declare `"sideEffects": false` — bundlers would silently drop the CSS import. It must mark CSS files as side-effectful.
React components are thin wrappers over the CSS core: no inline styles for appearance, no CSS-in-JS, no visual logic that belongs in `@lyra-ds/styles`.
No runtime CDN dependencies. Icons must come from the local static Lucide name-to-component map; flag dynamic icon imports that would pull the whole icon set into consumer bundles.
Alpine `x-for` templates must render exactly one root element; use a `display: contents` wrapper when a component needs multiple children.
Alpine `:class` bindings must use object syntax, not string syntax — string syntax does not remove classes already present in server-rendered markup.

Component documentation pages must follow the multi-stack pattern (React / Alpine / Blade / HTML stack tabs). Flag component pages that bypass it, and user-facing strings added to only one of the two locales (en, pt-BR).
